title: Open-source ACIS candidate admission and native-tool boundary
mode: Primary-source project documentation and issue-status research
scope: Screen additional open-source CAD/kernel and viewer projects for implemented ACIS SAT/SAB parsing and semantic evidence.
Separate open-source code, proprietary parser components, format matrices, wireframe projections, and geometry-kernel validation.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 optional candidate gate without changing local implementation order or adding routine dependencies.

sources.revision: Mutable README and format matrix reviewed 2026-10-20; no commit or executable was pinned.
sources.observed: The project README advertises broad format coverage, while its ACIS SAT/SAB matrix entries for read and write are unchecked.
sources.limits: A README matrix is project-authored scope evidence, not implementation or a successful parse. The route was not built or run.

sources.revision: Mutable disclosure reviewed 2026-10-20; no licensed parser package or executable was accessed.
sources.observed: The disclosure separates the open-source viewer from a proprietary DWG parser. It describes partial 3DSOLID/SAB decoding and best-effort wireframe or bounding-box output, and identifies the default open-source DWG route as LibreDWG-based.
sources.limits: The proprietary path is not an open-source implementation; wireframe/bounds do not establish B-rep semantics. No parser was installed or run.

sources.project: Open Cascade CAD Assistant and commercial components
sources.revision: Official product page and component announcement reviewed 2026-10-20; product page identifies CAD Assistant v1.6.0 dated 2021-10-05 and an OCCT 7.7.0 component announcement dated 2022-11-21.
sources.observed: The official pages identify ACIS SAT/SAB import as provided through commercial Open Cascade components and state that models imported using commercial components cannot be exported or converted.
sources.limits: This is not an open-source ACIS reader API or an automated per-body validation result. The product and component were not installed or run.

sources.revision: Issue status and mutable NEWS reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: Issue #1411 is open without an assignee or linked branch/PR at review time and provides a locally generatable AC1032 REGION/SAB carrier-loss discriminator. NEWS describes AcDsPrototype_1b extraction as incomplete/heuristic.
sources.limits: The issue's private AutoCAD sample was not available, and its reproduction was not run. Peer issue reports and project notes are not an independent ACIS semantic result.

sources.revision: Current ezdxf stable documentation, cadmpeg-asm 0.6.1 docs, and the previously pinned cq-acis 0.3.12 source commit were reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: ezdxf documents limited known ACIS support and no kernel. The existing plan's cadmpeg and cq-acis candidates remain bounded, separately implemented bare-SAB routes with distinct neutral-B-rep and OCCT-backed evidence ceilings.
sources.limits: Documentation does not prove runtime acceptance or independence of source/test data. Exact profile checks, lineage review, and actual results remain required at the composed checkpoint.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: explicitly exclude unimplemented ACIS matrices, proprietary/derivative DWG routes, and wireframe/bounding-box projections from open-source semantic-witness admission.
PAR-07/S8: retain cadmpeg-asm and cq-acis as bounded optional bare-SAB candidates; require exact profile, source lineage, payload hash, and body-level results.
External validation cadence: allow already-available CAD Assistant only as supplemental manual observation; do not add commercial components or native app requirements to local slices.

planChanges: Added a source-backed candidate screen distinguishing CADKernel's unchecked ACIS matrix, cad-viewer's proprietary/LibreDWG-derived paths and partial wireframe fallback, and CAD Assistant's commercial ACIS component from open-source parser/kernel evidence.
Recorded LibreDWG issue #1411's current open/no-linked-fix status and kept its scratch-generated case as a carrier-loss discriminator rather than semantic proof.

Made exact-profile bare-SAB checks and lineage review the only admitted automated optional semantic routes in this candidate screen; limited CAD Assistant to supplemental manual evidence if already installed and authorized.
Preserved local implementation order, fast-test cadence, no-external-fixture policy, and all six DEFERRED_EXTERNAL support gates.
limitations: All evidence is primary-source documentation or issue status, not peer runtime validation.
Mutable project pages were not pinned to repository commits unless a pinned source artifact already existed in the plan.
No product, proprietary parser, kernel, or peer executable was installed or run.
No external DWG/DXF sample was downloaded or added to the repository.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
